resources.string: Make room for what comes next.
Review temporary files, orphaned files and exact duplicate images stored by FancyAI.
Models, conversations, drafts and referenced images are protected. Caches used by running services are kept until those services finish.
Temporary files and regenerable caches, including engine, code and external caches. Cleared engine caches are rebuilt when needed, so the next model load may take longer.
Some saved content could not be read. Cache cleanup is available; orphan and duplicate cleanup will be available after the saved content can be read.
Unused chat attachments, unfinished image archives and image metadata with no image. Gallery photos are never treated as orphans.
Identical image files with identical saved metadata. One copy is kept; images used by saved content are protected.
This cannot be undone. Selected duplicate images will also disappear from their albums. The copy shown as kept will remain.
